text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, when I arrived at the 
track early, I heard a spirited, 
commanding voice.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Keep running! Don't stop, keep those legs 
pumping!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...! Alright! Senpai! New 
personal best!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, just like I told you, right? Don't 
overstep, focus on your cadence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli was giving instructions to 
a large group of students. Her presence 
was as dependable as an instructor's, but—

text_block_list.name: Timid Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah, what should we do... It's 
Sirius-senpai and her delinquent crew...!

text_block_list.name: Earnest Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
This is troubling. At this rate, there's 
no room for us to train...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, all the students outside 
the track had troubled looks on their 
faces. What was going on here...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sirius-senpai, may I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Complaints have reached the student 
council that you are unlawfully occupying 
the track with a large entourage.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, could you please clear the area 
so as not to disrupt other students?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at their faces. ...Well? You 
get it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Every last one of 'em broke curfew or 
school rules. Forced to write pointless 
reflection essays every single time, they 
barely have time to train properly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm watching over them. 
Securing them the time and space to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However... that is because they broke the 
rules. Without strict adherence to the 
regulations, the academy cannot function.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying for the sake of "rules", 
it's fine to shut these guys out?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah, I don't buy that crap.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In this academy, everything is a waiting 
list. And once you break a rule, that's 
it— you get shoved further and further 
down the line.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you had unavoidable circumstances 
and had no choice but to break them, the 
system couldn't care less.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In other words, completely ignoring 
personal circumstances is what this 
academy's "rules" are all about.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And if we play by the "rules", every 
single one of these guys is finished. 
—Ain't that right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And one more thing. You said complaints 
came to the student council, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then where's that king of yours, huh? If 
she's got something to say, she should 
come here herself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is a good chance—pass this along to 
her. If she plans to keep watching from 
her high horse, then I'm not gonna listen 
to a damn word she says.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, guys, back to it! Run! Keep moving 
forward!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli resumed giving instructions 
to the students. Even as she played the 
troublemaker, there was something 
undeniably dependable about her.
